text:
Alex Kim: quick async standup:
- yesterday: updated Node quickstart to use SDK v0.9.4, added auth snippet fix, opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/789
- blocker: sampleapp CI failing on macOS wheels (native deps) — can't repro locally on linux
- today: land doc patch, add a note about env var handling, and try a macOS CI rerun

Maria Chen: nice! can you add an explicit step for REDWOOD_API_KEY env var? people keep missing it. also include example curl + SDK snippet side-by-side.

Samir Patel: @Alex Kim i'll add the env var note and inline curl example to the PR. also spotted a typo in the quickstart command: `npm i @redwood/inference` should be `npm i @redwood/inference@^0.9` — i'll push a small commit.

Jordan Lee: FYI I'll review #789 later today, heads down until noon. If CI flaps, ping me and i can reroute a dedicated runner.

Alex Kim: thanks @Samir @Jordan. leaving a short changelog entry at top of the doc. pushed one small fix.

deploy-bot: Build #876 (sampleapp-macos) failed — wheel build error: 
```
ERROR: Failed building wheel for tokenizers
clang: error: unknown argument: '-fopenmp'
```
(see https://ci.redwood-inference.internal/builds/876)

Maria Chen: looks like tokenizers native build needs openmp — we should either pin a prebuilt wheel or add a note to use the binary distribution. can we fallback to pure-python on macos in the sample app?

Samir Patel: quick workaround: in sampleapp requirements we can pin `tokenizers==0.11.6` which has universal wheels, or add a `pip install --no-build-isolation tokenizers-binary` step. i'll try pin first and re-run CI.

DevEx Bot: @Samir CI requeue requested for Build #876 (user: Samir Patel) — queued on macos-runner-2

Jordan Lee: if CI still fails after pin, i can spin up an m1 runner to reproduce. also note: once docs landed, we'll need to update the Quickstarts page meta (frontmatter) to bump the SDK version.

Alex Kim: good call. frontmatter snippet i'm planning to add:
```
---
title: "Node quickstart"
sidebar_position: 2
sdk_version: "0.9.4"
---
```

Maria Chen: perfect. small nit: can we add a cross-link to the sampleapp repo and a short troubleshooting section for mac/os/archs? just 3 bullets. saves support pings.

Samir Patel: noted, adding troubleshooting bullets and a pointer to sampleapp issues. will re-run CI in ~10m.

Alex Kim: thanks team — i'll merge once CI is green and @Jordan gave review. if anything blocks, i'll update the PR description with known flaky items. :thumbsup:
